FYI Yachts was honored to be a sponsor of the 2024 Awards Luncheon hosted by the Latin Builders Association (LBA) on Friday, September 27, 2024, at the prestigious Trump National Doral. This annual event brought together leaders from various industries to celebrate excellence, innovation, and community leadership within the Latin business community.

As a company that values collaboration and community growth, FYI Yachts was proud to stand alongside influential figures and organizations. We extend our heartfelt thanks to the LBA for the invitation and for organizing such a remarkable event.

The highlight of the afternoon was the lineup of exceptional guest speakers. In addition to our esteemed keynote speaker, United States Senator Marco Rubio, we were thrilled to hear from Maximo Alvarez, President of Sunshine Gasoline Distributors, Inc. His inspiring words, combined with Senator Rubio’s insightful remarks, set the tone for a powerful and thought-provoking luncheon.

We look forward to continuing our involvement in these significant events and we are optimistic that this is just the beginning of many future collaborations. We extend our sincere gratitude to the LBA for welcoming us and allowing FYI Yachts to be part of the exciting opportunities that lie ahead.
